units.text: The 2025 Physiology or Medicine prize was shared by three laureates: Mary E. Brunkow, Fred Ramsdell, and Shimon Sakaguchi.

judgement.reason: The passage lists the 2025 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine as awarded to Mary E. Brunkow, Fred Ramsdell, and Shimon Sakaguchi.

units.text: The 2025 Economic Sciences prize was awarded to a single laureate, not three.

judgement.reason: The passage mentions the 2025 prize and its citation but does not state whether it was awarded to one laureate or three.

units.text: The Nobel Prizes in Literature, Peace, and Economic Sciences are not science prizes; only Physics, Chemistry, and Physiology or Medicine qualify as Nobel science prizes.

judgement.reason: The passages show Physics and Chemistry as Nobel Prizes and refer to the Economic Sciences prize as a separate Sveriges Riksbank award in memory of Alfred Nobel, but they do not state that Literature and Peace are not science prizes or that only Physics, Chemistry, and Physiology or Medicine qualify as Nobel science prizes.
